## Phase A - Intake & Localization
Drive upload simulates the mobile app. Filename convention: `report_<reporterEmail>_<freetext>.jpg`.
Replace before running: **folder ID** (node 1), **MultiSet Basic-auth credential** (node 4), **mapCode** (node 5), **IFC service URL** (node 7).
Camera intrinsics are derived from the image in node 3 - override the CONFIG block there with your phone's real fx/fy/px/py.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ mapCode: 'REPLACE_WITH_MULTISET_MAP_CODE', isRightHanded: false, width: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.width, height: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.height, fx: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.fx, fy: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.fy, px: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.px, py: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.py, queryImage: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.imageB64 }) }}

parameters.subject: =[CBM] Ticket #{{ $json.id }} needs manual localization
parameters.message:
=

A new fault report could not be localized automatically (low VPS confidence).

Photo: open
Reporter: {{ $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.reporterEmail }}

Please localize the object manually and re-dispatch. Ticket status: NEEDS_TRIAGE.

parameters.query: =SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE ifc_global_id = '{{ $json.global_id }}' AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED','DUPLICATE') LIMIT 1;

=INSERT INTO tickets (status, reporter_email, photo_before_url, ifc_global_id, ifc_class, description)
VALUES ('DUPLICATE', '{{ $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.reporterEmail }}', '{{ $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.photoUrl }}', '{{ $('Find IFC Element').first().json.global_id }}', '{{ $('Find IFC Element').first().json.ifc_class }}', 'Duplicate of open ticket #{{ $json.id }}') RETURNING id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 500, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: $('Prepare Image & Metadata').first().json.imageB64 } }, { type: 'text', text: 'This photo shows a broken/faulty object inside a building (element type from BIM: ' + $('Find IFC Element').first().json.ifc_class + ', name: ' + $('Find IFC Element').first().json.name + '). Classify the fault. Respond ONLY with minified JSON, no markdown: {\"category\": string, \"severity\": integer 1-5, \"description\": short string, \"required_skill\": one of carpentry|plumbing|electrical|hvac|general}' } ] }] }) }}

New maintenance ticket #{{ $json.id }}

parameters.content:
## Phase B — Deterministic Dispatch (SQL)
Eligibility = hard SQL filters (skill, zone, active). Ranking = load balance → fairness (`last_assigned_at ASC NULLS FIRST`: never-assigned technicians go FIRST, fixing the cold-start problem) → rating.
The loop contacts ONE technician at a time (Constraint 1). Offer email has only Accept/Deny links with a FIXED slot (Constraint 2).

parameters.query: =SELECT t.id AS technician_id, t.full_name, t.email, t.rating, COALESCE(o.open_jobs, 0) AS open_jobs, t.last_assigned_at FROM technicians t LEFT JOIN (SELECT technician_id, count(*) AS open_jobs FROM tickets WHERE status IN ('ASSIGNED','WORK_DONE','PENDING_APPROVAL','REWORK') GROUP BY technician_id) o ON o.technician_id = t.id WHERE t.active = TRUE AND '{{ $('Parse Triage JSON').first().json.required_skill }}' = ANY(t.skills) AND t.zone = 'building-A' ORDER BY COALESCE(o.open_jobs, 0) ASC, t.last_assigned_at ASC NULLS FIRST, t.rating DESC LIMIT 5;
=UPDATE tickets SET status='DISPATCHING', updated_at=now() WHERE id={{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }} RETURNING id;

parameters.subject: =[CBM] Job offer - ticket #{{ $json.ticketId }}: {{ $json.description }}
parameters.message:
=

Maintenance job offer

Hello {{ $json.full_name }},

Object: {{ $json.elementName }} ({{ $json.ifcClass }})
Issue: {{ $json.description }} (severity {{ $json.severity }}/5)
Photo: open
Date: {{ $json.proposedDate }} · Slot: {{ $json.proposedSlot }} (fixed - cannot be changed)

✅ ACCEPT the job  |  ❌ DENY

If you do not respond within 4 hours the offer expires automatically.

parameters.query: =WITH t AS (UPDATE tickets SET status='ASSIGNED', technician_id={{ $('Offer Loop (one at a time)').last().json.technician_id }}, scheduled_date='{{ $('Offer Loop (one at a time)').last().json.proposedDate }}', scheduled_slot='{{ $('Offer Loop (one at a time)').last().json.proposedSlot }}', updated_at=now() WHERE id={{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }} RETURNING id, technician_id) UPDATE technicians SET last_assigned_at=now() WHERE id=(SELECT technician_id FROM t) RETURNING id;

parameters.subject: =[CBM] Confirmed - ticket #{{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }}
parameters.message:
=

Thank you! The job is yours.

Date: {{ $('Offer Loop (one at a time)').last().json.proposedDate }} · Slot: {{ $('Offer Loop (one at a time)').last().json.proposedSlot }}

When finished, photograph the repaired object and upload it to the shared Drive folder 02_completed_snapshots naming the file TICKET-{{ $('Create Ticket').first().json.id }}_after.jpg.
